labels.quote: Tenant may renew this Lease for one (1) additional period of five (5) years (the “Renewal Term”), by delivering written notice of the exercise thereof to Landlord between Lease Months 31 and 34 (or earlier).
labels.note: Notice is due during Lease Months 31-34 (or earlier), measured from the start of the term, not before expiration; given the Lease Month count conflict noted on expiration_date, notice_months is omitted. The option ends on any assignment or sublease.

labels.value: Assignment, subletting or encumbrance requires Landlord's prior written consent, not to be unreasonably withheld, conditioned or delayed; certain merger, asset-sale and affiliate assignments are allowed without consent on 15 business days' notice.
labels.quote: Tenant shall not directly or indirectly, by operation of law or otherwise, assign, sublet, mortgage, hypothecate or otherwise encumber all or any portion of its interest in this Lease or in the Premises or grant any license in any person other than Tenant or its employees to use or occupy the Premises or any part thereof without obtaining the prior written consent of Landlord, which consent shall not be unreasonably withheld, conditioned, or delayed.
